name: priority-ask-question
title: The priority reader answers an AskUserQuestion call from its pane
outcome: With the reader on, a main-loop AskUserQuestion call opens a question card in the pane at once, and the engine dialog does not open. A reading of that point fills in beside the questions. The person's choice in the pane answers the call, and the agent goes on.
done_when: A live probe records if a tool.call hook can hold an AskUserQuestion call open for two minutes, and the exact shape of an answer that the engine accepts
priority interpret --open-question reads the questions from a file, and the reading records stop_kind question
With the reader on, a main-loop AskUserQuestion call opens the pane with each question and its options, and no dialog opens
A pick of options, or text under Other, then Send, answers the call, and the agent receives those answers
A subagent call, a call with the reader off, or a pane that cannot open lets the engine dialog open as before
abort_if: The probe shows that a hook cannot hold the call open, and the fallback dialog with a reading in the pane does not work either

min_work.derived_from: 2 districts (scripts, docs), 3 ADRs (ADR-0045, ADR-0049, ADR-0025), 1 boundary rule (priority-dev only as a process)
min_work.note: Stages 3 and 4 ran inline in this session, with no subagents.
